soren (People Ops): Quick practical guide for managers prepping reviews this cycle 1: evidence expectations, comp notes separation, and accessibility options. Read before you submit. :bookmark_tabs:

soren (People Ops): Topline dates: peer feedback due `2026-03-31`, manager review due `2026-04-10 23:59 PDT`, calibration `2026-04-13 -> 2026-04-17`, final lock `2026-04-24`. Appeals window `2026-04-24`->`2026-04-29`.

soren (People Ops): Evidence checklist (paste into the "add evidence" area):
- 1 line summary of outcome (metric or customer quote)
- Link to primary artifact (PR, ticket, demo recording)
- Optional secondary artifact (design doc, cohort analysis)
Example: `Checkout v2 -> +18% conv (Amplitude), PR#4521, demo: drive.google.com/drive/fake-link`

zara (People Ops): Note on comp-sensitive items: do NOT discuss offer/comp negotiations in the public calibration notes. If a rating influences comp decisions, add a private flag in the form: `CompImpact: true` and email people-ops@redwood.com + cc finance. We'll pull the case into a separate review with Finance.

matt (Eng Manager): For cross-functional ICs where designers or sales contributed, how granular should evidence be? My PMs often have lots of contextual notes.

soren (People Ops): Keep evidence focused: 1 primary artifact per contribution (link) + 1 sentence explaining the IC's role. If cross-team context matters, add a short "Cross-team context" bullet and ping the other manager to join calibration.

deepa (IC): Accessibility ask 1 my manager promised captions for my demo recording. How do we request accommodations for calibration slots?

accessibility-bot: If you need accommodations (longer slot, captions, ASL), reply to this thread with "Accessibility: [need]" and People Ops will schedule accordingly. For recordings, upload transcripts to the evidence field.

alisa (Finance): Quick finance note: when you flag `CompImpact: true`, include the compensation bucket recommendation (range) in the private email. Do not put numbers in the public form.

soren (People Ops): Small pro tip: use the short calibration note template in the form (paste):
```
Context: [one line]
Impact: [metric or customer quote]
Artifact: [link to PR/ticket/demo]
Recommendation: [Meet / Exceed / Below] + 1 sentence rationale
```

soren (People Ops): Final reminders: 1) RSVP to your calibration invite when it arrives, 2) attach at least one evidence link per review, 3) use `CompImpact: true` + email for comp cases, 4) request accessibility in-thread if needed. Ping us here for any form bugs. :raised_hands:

matt (Eng Manager): Thanks 1 I'll prep the evidence links and flag two cross-functional contributors for follow-up.

zara (People Ops): Acknowledge 1 will monitor and help route any comp-related threads.

soren (People Ops): Appreciate it 1 reach out if anything blocks submission.
